br.Flanco: Flanco: Golpe veloz x2, Ataque x1

en.Atacante: Attacker: Quick Strike x1, Attack x1

en.Flanco: Flanker: Quick Strike x2, Attack x1

en.Caçador: Hunter: Future Attack x1, Anti-heal x2

en.Férias: Summer: Attack x2, Revitalize (Doubles your healing on the next turn)
